Whys analysis was made popular at Toyota as a standard process for root
cause analysis—getting to the heart of a problem.

text.tspan: User scenarios help you understand your user and how they interact with
Scenarios are a useful UX design artifact that can help you cultivate em
pathy for your user and design the best solutions for them.
When you map your scenarios intelligently to your users’ journey, you can
create a user experience that they’ll want to repeat.
